title: Migrate AzureAIAgent (backed by Azure Foundry) to new SDK version
body: This issue is to track efforsts to update the AzureAIAgent (backed by Azure Foundry) to new SDK version released at Build.

linked_prs.title: feat: [draft] update version of azureaiagent
linked_prs.body: There have been updates to the azure ai agent foundry sdk (azure-ai-project). This PR updates the autogen `AzureAIAgent` which wraps the azure ai agent. A list of some changes - Update docstring samples to use `endpoint` (instead of connection string previously) - Update imports and arguments e.g, from `azure.ai.agents` etc - Add a guide in ext docs showing Bing Search Grounding tool example. ## Why are these changes needed? ## Related issue number Closes #6601 ## Checks - [ ] I've included any doc changes needed for . See to build and test documentation locally. - [ ] I've added tests (if relevant) corresponding to the changes introduced in this PR. - [ ] I've made sure all auto checks have passed.
